conf.description: Facility SNMP APC/NMC data.txt tab-delimited data-log direct route (NOT the same file as ups-trap's event.txt): best-effort positional column split, per recommendations.direct.cribl (no vendor pack/integration exists; per-model column order is unconfirmed - see README gap)

conf.comment: APC NMC data.txt fetched by an external scheduled FTP/SCP pull - the periodic measurement log, distinct from the event.txt the sibling ups-trap csv-file pipeline parses. ASSUMPTION (no sample row given): tab-delimited columns in the order Date, Time, probe-temp, probe-humidity, TupsC, Vout, %Wout, Vbat, Freq, matching this work order's own field list order - NOT a confirmed on-wire order. The catalog states the exact column set varies by device model/firmware and the header is not self-describing beyond mnemonic labels; a per-model header-driven parse would need cross-event state (the header row is a separate event from its data rows) which the whitelisted, stateless functions here cannot provide. This positional parse is a known best-effort gap - see README. Assumes 'card IP' is already attached as a per-row field by the collector (header-block-scoped, not per-row, same assumption as ups-trap's csv-file pipeline).

functions.description: Pipeline purpose and heaviest assumption in this work order: unconfirmed positional column order

Positional tab-split into clean staging names chosen here (sidesteps the source having awkward names like %Wout) - column ORDER is the unconfirmed assumption from the comment above, not the destination names

Computed fields before rename: four-digit-year Date + Time composed into _time (never @timestamp, platform constraint), observer.ip from the space-named header-block field via bracket access ('card IP' would fail a path-based rename)

Batch rename of the clean staging fields our own serde extraction produced. apc.iem.probe.temperature is left UNCONVERTED - see README gap: the card's display-unit config (Celsius vs Fahrenheit) is not present in the row on this transport, unlike the trap/poll formats which carry a units enum alongside the reading

event.dataset (no hyphen, shared with the trap/poll routes' data stream), event.provider distinct from ups-trap's 'nmc_event_log' since this is the data log not the event log, and cleanup of the two staging fields consumed into _time
Re-nest flat dotted keys (data-maps canonical step)
